sammendrag: Emphasizing results from quasi-experimental and experimental research, in this chapter I identify approaches designed to help adult literacy students and secondary school dropouts transition to higher education. Three types of interventions aimed at increasing the readiness of low-skilled students for postsecondary education and career are identified, including (a) efforts to align the high school equivalency credentialing and curricula in adult education with postsecondary- and career-readiness standards; (b) adult education to college bridge programs, which provide more contextualized instruction and career readiness supports aimed at easing the transition to postsecondary education; and (c) concurrent enrollment adult education programs that allow students to enroll in postsecondary classes while still working on their high school credential and increasing their skills. Several areas for reform for the field are also identified that could aid in larger scale improvements in low-skilled adults transition to higher education.
tittel: Transitioning Adult Literacy Students to Postsecondary Education
